title: Applications Of Nanotechnology
definition: Nanotechnology involves the manipulation of matter on an atomic, molecular, and supramolecular scale—typically between 1 to 100 nanometers—to create materials with radically altered physical, chemical, and biological properties due to increased surface-area-to-volume ratio and quantum effects.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper III (Science and Technology - Awareness in the fields of IT, Space, Computers, robotics, nano-technology, bio-technology and issues relating to intellectual property rights). Tested frequently across Prelims (applications in medicine, agriculture, environmental remediation) and Mains (ethical issues, toxicity, socioeconomic benefits, and Nano Mission initiatives in India).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Applications Of Nanotechnology.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Physics, Chemistry, and Biology at Higher Secondary Level
Basic understanding of modern scientific missions in India
